preconditions.description: The grid has between 2 and 1000 rows and columns.
There are between 1 and 10000 days to process.

preconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] != '#' for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if (i, j) not in {(0, 0), (h-1, w-1)})
preconditions.description: The house and school are never blocked.

preconditions.expression: all(can_reach(grid, (0, 0), (h-1, w-1)) for grid in all_grids)
preconditions.description: A day with no cells temporarily blocked by snow is interesting.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 'YES' if interesting[i] else 'NO' for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: The output should indicate whether each day is interesting.

invariants.expression: all(grid == initial_grids[i] for i in range(q))
invariants.description: The grid does not change between days.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= len(blocks[i]) <= 10 for i in range(q))
invariants.description: Each day has between 1 and 10 cells temporarily blocked.

invariants.expression: all(len(set(blocks[i])) == len(blocks[i]) for i in range(q))
invariants.description: The cells temporarily blocked each day are distinct.

invariants.expression: all(all((ri, ci) not in {(0, 0), (h-1, w-1)} for ri, ci in blocks[i]) for i in range(q))
invariants.description: None of the cells temporarily blocked contains the house or the school.
